about:
Ranburne Steel Fabrication operates from Ranburne, Alabama, where it was founded in 1985 by Tim Johnson. The company began as a structural steel fabricator and has since expanded into a full-service provider for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.

The shop handles both structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, producing columns, beams, roof frames, stairs, railings, platforms, and other custom metalwork. In-house detailing and design teams use industry-standard software to accelerate project turnaround. The company also supplies joist and deck systems, structural fasteners, and coordinates metal plate galvanizing. Its AWS-qualified fabricators have completed thousands of projects ranging from 5 tons to over 2,000 tons, all fabricated with modern equipment.

Customers include general contractors and owners of warehouses, multi-level storage facilities, schools, hospitals, and other commercial and industrial buildings. The firm serves the Southeast and ships nationally, acting as a single source for structural steel, miscellaneous metals, detailing, and related materials.

Ranburne Steel emphasizes its AISC certification, in-house design capability, and a one-stop-shop model that covers everything from raw steel to the final bolt. The company cites long-standing customer relationships and rapid turnaround as key reasons clients return.
